items.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: we had the Duke Blue Devils, now you know who they were, that was Les Brown.

ctx.x: And things were so rough during those days, people saved up twenty cents to go hear a band. Then we had the college bands. The college bands, Alabama State Collegians which became the Erskine Hawkins Orchestra, and which became a place where I spent most of my life, the best years of my life, recording years. Then we had some bands from Florida A&M College. In other words, during those days the college bands was the thing, because there was only, a kid didn’t have to have a scholarship, all he could do is play,…
They’re more for concerts, not dancing though.
